risks.title: Goodwill and intangible asset impairment charges
risks.score_rationale: The company recorded a $671M impairment charge in Q3 FY2025 affecting Versace and Jimmy Choo. The document indicates that additional future impairments are possible if market conditions further deteriorate.

risks.title: Adverse macroeconomic conditions
risks.score_rationale: The company explicitly identifies the impact of global macroeconomic conditions, inflation, high interest rates, energy costs, political instability, and currency fluctuations as negative factors affecting demand for discretionary luxury goods.

risks.title: Customs tariffs and trade restrictions
risks.score_rationale: The majority of products sold in the United States are imported from countries subject to tariffs announced in April 2025 (Vietnam, Cambodia, Indonesia, Bangladesh). The potential impact on margins and costs is significant.

risks.title: Manufacturing cost volatility
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to volatility in raw material costs, labor expenses, and commodity prices, which may affect gross margins.

risks.title: Luxury goods demand trends
risks.score_rationale: Demand for discretionary luxury items is sensitive to economic conditions. The document indicates an ongoing weakening of consumer demand for fashion luxury products.

risks.title: Information systems failures
risks.score_rationale: The company relies heavily on its information systems to manage its operational and commercial activities, making it vulnerable to system failures or cyberattacks.
